text: EXT. FOREST - DAY1 1
location: EXT FOREST

text: An injured rabbit, eyes glowing red, struggles desperately. Avery, 20’s, holding a small basket with herbs, notices the rabbit and approaches it. AVERYPoor little bunny, let me help you. Two rouge wolves hide behind a tree, watching in the shadows. Avery kneels down and covers the rabbit’s body. A purple light flashes, the rabbit's wound heals and it runs away. Avery smiles as a big net suddenly falls and covers her. She struggles in shock. The two rogues approaches her. ROGUE 1Look what a little bunny brought us. AVERY(struggles)Let me go! Rogue 2 gets closer to Avery and smells her scent. ROGUE 2Hmm, another tasty little bunny. Suddenly, a LOUD GROWL erupts from the forest, causing everyone to shrink in fear. An arrow with fire shoots between the two Rogues and they see a huge black wolf walking towards them. ROGUE 1Oh my god! It’s Alpha Xavier! Run! Rogues are scared and flee in panic. The wolf turns into human. It’s Xavier, 23’s. He walks to Avery who crouches underneath the net and stares at Xavier curiously. Xavier stops in front of Avery and lifts the net over her. He bends down and holds out his hands to her, trying to help her up. XAVIERIt’s okay. I scared them off. You're safe now. The light shines on Xavier's back. Avery looks at Xavier who stands before her and looks her over with his beautiful blue eyes, Avery's heart beats. Avery puts her hand on Xavier’s and gets up. She slips and is about to fall, but Xavier quickly catches her.

A golden line appears and wraps around them. They’re both surprised. When Avery realizes it’s the mate bond, she becomes thrilled all of a sudden. AVERYYou’re my mate. Thank the Moon Goddess for remembering me! I finally found you! Mate, what’s your name? Avery grabs Xavier’s arm, looking into his eyes with excitement. Xavier is captivated by her enthusiasm. XAVIERXavier. You’re an Omega? AVERYUm, I guess so…… I’m Avery. My home is in a cave right behind these woods. It’s small, but I made it into like a real home. We can live here after we get married... Avery pulls on Xavier’s arm, dragging him toward her home. Xavier stumbles a few steps before steadying himself and gently removes Avery’s hand. XAVIERSorry, Avery, I can’t accept you as my mate. AVERY(shocked)What? Why? Before Xavier could say something, Isabel, 23’s, suddenly comes out of the forest. ISABELBecause he already has a mate. Avery is shocked to see Isabel rushes to Xavier and holds his arms, kisses his cheek and then looks at Avery defiantly.
INT. THE MOUNTAIN PACK - LIVING ROOM - DAY3
location: INT THE MOUNTAIN PACK - LIVING ROOM

text: Xavier and Isabel walks in the living room hands by hands, Avery follows them. Xavier turns to Avery. XAVIERYou can stay here until your wound recovers. After that I'll send you back to your own pack.

AVERY(sadly)I don’t have a pack. I live in the woods alone. Xavier is shocked. He wants to say more. But Hayley, 40- 50's, walks in and interrupts him. HAYLEYOh, my poor girl. Xavier, you can’t send her away. Hayley walks towards Avery and pulls Avery into a tight hug. HAYLEY(CONT'D)You must be Avery, Xavier’s mate. You’re so beautiful! I don't know how my hot-headed son got paired with a delicate girl like you. Xavier interrupts them. He pulls Isabel into his arm, making a statement of his authority. XAVIERI won’t accept Avery as my Luna. I want Isabel. She is the Luna in my heart. Avery looks at Xavier’s hand on Isabel’s shoulder sadly. Hayley looks at Avery heartily and then holds her hand to comfort her. HAYLEY(to Xavier)That’s ridiculous! Your mate is chosen by the moon goddess. And that’s Avery! ISABELThen the Moon goddess must be joking, pairing the strongest Alpha with a weak rogue Omega. XAVIERYes, Avery's too weak. I cannot risk the safety of our pack for her. Avery walks towards Xavier, determination shines in her eyes. AVERYWhat if I become stronger? Will you accept me? ISABEL(laughs)Come on, Omega. How strong could you be?

I am the future Luna and you’re a poor orphaned wolf-less rogue who is totally useless. Hayley slaps Isabel on her face. HAYLEYShow some respect to the future Luna of the Mountain pack! Isabel covers her face and looks at Xavier who moves her behind him. Avery sees. She bites her lower lip, fingernails embedded in the palm to keep herself from crying. HAYLEY(CONT'D)(to Xavier)Xavier, you finally found your true mate! You'll finally have something other than your workaholic life. Don’t ruin this for the benefit of the pack. XAVIERMy father sacrificed everything to make us the most powerful pack. I won’t let anything destroy it. I’m going to marry Isabel. HAYLEY(stern)Enough! None of us will accept Isabel as your Luna. Xavier, you and Avery will hold a wedding ceremony on the next full moon. It’s settled. ISABEL(displeased)What?! A look of resentment comes over Xavier's face.
EXT. THE MOUNTAIN PACK - LAWN - DAY4 4
location: EXT THE MOUNTAIN PACK - LAWN

text: Avery is in a white wedding dress, slowly walking towards Xavier. Her eyes glance at the guests around her. All eyes lock on her. She smiles. Xavier extends his hand towards Avery. Hesitant, she grabs his hand and joins him. PRIEST, 30-50, joins the two of them and begins his speech. PRIESTThank you all for joining us today.

Xavier interrupts him. XAVIER(aggravated)Let’s cut the crap, and get this over with. Shall we? The priest clears his throat. PRIESTDo you, Xavier Ralston, accept this woman as your mate, and Luna of the Mountain Pack? XAVIERI, Xavier Ralston, Alpha of the Mountain Pack, take Avery Gomez as my mate……(hesitates for a second)And Luna. PRIEST(motions to Avery)Do you accept this man as your mate and Alpha? AVERYI, Avery Gomez, accept Xavier Ralston as my mate and Alpha. Guests begin to cheer and clap. PRIESTIn sickness and in... XAVIER(interrupts)That’s enough. Next. Priest gives Xavier a ceremonious dagger, sharp and with intricate designs. Xavier runs the dagger across his right thumb, piercing his flesh. He then hands it to Avery. XAVIER(CONT'D)Do what I just did. Avery grips the dagger, and slices the blade over her skin. The priest takes their hands, presses their thumbs together. Visible on both of their faces, a change within them has occurred. AVERY & XAVIER (O.S.)What a strange feeling. The priest gives them two rings to exchange. Xavier slips the ring onto Avery's finger, Avery gently grabs his hand, and places the ring onto his finger.

PRIESTI now pronounce you Xavier Ralston and Avery Gomez as the Alpha and Luna of the Mountain Pack. Alpha, you may now kiss your Luna. Xavier slowly pulls Avery closer. He leans down and brushes his mouth near her lips and whispers. XAVIERYou get what you want, Omega. Avery’s fingers trails across Xavier's chest, stops at where his heart is, and whispers. AVERYThis is what I want, My Alpha. Xavier grabs her hand on his chest, looks into her eyes, and then kisses her quickly. XAVIERDon't overthink this. I'm just following the procedure.
INT. THE MOUNTAIN PACK - XAVIER’S ROOM - NIGHT5
location: INT THE MOUNTAIN PACK - XAVIER’S ROOM

text: Avery enters the room with the wedding dress and starts to undress it, until there only leaves a thin underskirt. XAVIER(V.O.)Why are you here? Frightened, Avery turns and bumps into Xavier’s arms who only wears a towel and just walks out of the bathroom. As Avery screams out in shock, Xavier wraps his arms around her waist to help her steady herself. Avery’s hands press on Xavier’s chest. XAVIERYou okay? Avery hasn’t recovered from the shock. She looks at her hand on Xavier’s chest and scratches his chest twice. XAVIER(CONT'D)How long are you going to stay like that? AVERY(embarrassed)Oh, sorry. Avery takes her hands back and moves one step backward. Xavier’s towel falls.

Avery looks down and sees Xavier naked which makes her shocked and embarrassed. She accidentally drags Xavier and two of them fall in bed together. Avery falls on Xavier’s body. Two of them looks at each other. Xavier’s breath become heavy. He wraps his arms around Avery and rolls over on one side to pin her underneath him. He looks deeply in her eyes. XAVIER(with forbearance)What are you doing in my room? AVERYUm…… Hayley said that we should stay together since we’re mates…… Avery tries to push Xavier away but she fails. Xavier pins Avery firmly in the bed, his nose caressing her neck as he takes a deep inhale of her scent. AVERY(CONT'D)I think I should……leave. XAVIERIt’s late. Xavier kisses Avery's soft flesh. He bites and sucks on her neck, Avery whimpers. They share a deep kiss. A nearby vase falls and breaks into pieces. As if electricity shot through him, Xavier rears back and gets out of the bed. He breathes heavily and wraps the towel back. XAVIER(CONT'D)I’m sorry. Your pheromones, the mate bond between us, they're affecting me. Avery gets up and sits on the bed awkwardly, touching her lips with her fingers as if replaying the kiss. AVERYOh, yep, the pheromones, yes. XAVIER(awkwardly)We should keep some distance. You can stay here and I’ll sleep in the guest room. Xavier walks to the door to leave but he cannot open it. There is a sound of the door being locked, followed by Hayley’s voice. HAYLEYEnjoy your wedding night my babes!
INT. THE MOUNTAIN PACK - HALLWAY OF XAVIER’S ROOM - NIGHT5a Hayley stands in the doorway of Xavier’s room, locking the door, with a gloating and smug look on her face.
INT. THE MOUNTAIN PACK - XAVIER’S ROOM - NIGHT6
location: INT THE MOUNTAIN PACK - XAVIER’S ROOM

text: Both Avery and Xavier turns to look at the door in shock. Xavier frowns and looks at Avery. AVERY(awkwardly)I guess we need to share the bed tonight. Xavier walks towards her. He stares at her as if he wants to see through her. XAVIER(angrily)Now I understand. This is your little trick, asked my mom to lock us together and seduce me. AVERYWhat? No! I knew nothing about this. The anger emanating from Xavier makes Avery unconsciously duck away. Xavier drags Avery’s legs to the edge of the bed. XAVIERYou'll get everything you wished for. He takes control of her fidgeting hands and presses them to the bed and kisses her. After a long kiss, Xavier lets go of Avery’s lips and she gets the chance to breath. AVERYWhat are you doing? XAVIERI'm doing what you wanted, what you conspired with my mother. To mate with me and be my Luna. Xavier spreads Avery’s legs and intends to go further. Suddenly Avery slaps him. Stunned, Xavier stops and stares at Avery, almost proud of her courage. XAVIER(CONT'D)No one has ever dared to do that.

AVERYThen you should know I'm different and I want more than a nominal marriage. XAVIER(angrily)You won’t get what you want. I can’t accept you as my Luna. Exasperated, Xavier grabs a pillow and quilt and places them on the floor before wraps himself in the quilt. Avery looks at Xavier and says to herself. AVERY (O.S.)I must do something to win his heart.
EXT. THE MOUNTAIN PACK - GARDEN - DAY7 7
location: EXT THE MOUNTAIN PACK - GARDEN

text: Avery runs in the garden when Isabel and Lily, 21’s, walk in. Two of them look at Avery. ISABELLook at her, a weak rogue omega suddenly becomes the Luna, how ridiculous. LILYShe really should go back to the forest. Lily walks towards Avery and blocks her path. AVERY(greet)Hi, I am…… LILY(disdain)The Omega. You’re not worthy of Alpha Xavier. Only Isabel deserves to be the Luna. Avery’s smile freeze. She squeezes her fists and takes two steps in Lily’s direction. AVERYWell, why don’t you become the moon goddess? Lily raises her hand to slap Avery on her face. LILY(screams)How dare you talk to me like that! You're just an omega!
Just be clear, we won't accept you as our Luna! Xavier suddenly enters the garden. XAVIERWhat are you doing here?
EXT. THE MOUNTAIN PACK - TRAINING GROUND - DAY10
location: EXT THE MOUNTAIN PACK - TRAINING GROUND

text: Avery and Darren look at each other. AVERY(in shock)Oh, thank you-What's your name? DARRENDarren- Avery leaves Darren’s arms and smiles excitedly. AVERYYou’re Darren! The strongest gamma in the mountain pack! DARRENNice to meet you, Luna. When Darren holds his hand to shake with Avery, Avery suddenly sees Darren’s bleeding arm. AVERYYou’re bleeding! Let me help you with it.

Avery and Darren sit on the chair. Avery starts to help Darren dress his wound, Darren looks at her, sunlight pours in her hair. DARRENIt’s okay. I get injured all the time, the training ground is not normally safe. AVERY(concerns)Lucky it’s not a deep cut. Avery finishes dressing the wound and looks up to see Darren’s eyes. DARRENWhat brings you here? Not exactly the usual spot for a Luna. AVERYUm……I accepted a challenge from Lily so I thought I might need some training. A petal falls onto Avery's head. Darren reaches out to grab it, but Avery instinctively dodges. Darren shows the petal to Avery, Avery laughs awkwardly while Darren looks at her and shows a doting smile. DARRENYou’re the Luna. You don’t need to answer to challenges. AVERYBut I want Xavier’s approval. I don’t want to lose. I just don’t know how to defeat Lily. She’s much stronger than me. Darren ponders for a moment. DARRENMaybe I can help you. AVERY(exciting & grateful)Really?! Thank you Darren, you are so sweet! DARRENMy pleasure, Luna. Darren takes a bow from the side and hands it to Avery, and then he comes round behind her and puts his arms round her to teach her how to draw the bow.

DARREN(CONT'D)How to draw the bow is the first lesson. From a distance, Xavier watches. His beta, Johnson, stands beside him. Xavier’s gaze turns icy. XAVIER(to Johnson)When did she get so close with Darren? JOHNSONI don’t know. Are we still training the Luna? XAVIERCan't you see someone else already is? And she's not the Luna. Xavier stares daggers at them from a distance. Unaware of Xavier's presence, Avery immerses in her training.
EXT. THE MOUNTAIN PACK - GARDEN - DAY8 8
location: EXT THE MOUNTAIN PACK - GARDEN

text: Isabel runs to Xavier and holds his arms. ISABELAvery is fighting with Lily. I can’t stop them. XAVIER(to Lily)What's the meaning of this? LILY(chuckling)Just saying hi to our new Luna. Avery’s upset as she stares at Isabel’s hand around Xavier’s arms. AVERYLily thinks I don’t deserve to be the Luna. LILY(disdainfully)It's the truth, right? ISABELI have an idea, why don’t we give Avery a chance to prove herself? LILYYeah! Avery, Why don't we make a bet? Accept my challenge. If you win, you’re acknowledged. If you lose, piss off to the forest. Xavier releases Isabel and approaches Avery. His Alpha aura makes everyone fall silent. Xavier stops in front of Avery. XAVIER(says to Avery)No need to, challenge or not, it won’t change the fact that you’re an Omega. Avery looks at Xavier with determination.
AVERYI accept the challenge. Maybe you will fall for me when I defeat Lily. XAVIERYou won’t. AVERYWe’ll see.
EXT. THE MOUNTAIN PACK - TRAINING GROUND - DAY9
location: EXT THE MOUNTAIN PACK - TRAINING GROUND

text: Avery enters the training ground where the pack members are training. Some are practicing with swords and others are practicing archery. Avery looks around with confusion, does not know where to start. Suddenly, an arrow flies at her. DARRENWatch out! Darren, 24’s, runs to Avery in a flash speed. He shields her in his arms, dodging the incoming arrow, which grazed the skin on Darren's arm and goes into the trunk of the tree behind them.
INT. THE MOUNTAIN PACK - VILLA - AVERY’S BATHROOM - NIGHT11
location: INT THE MOUNTAIN PACK - VILLA - AVERY’S BATHROOM

text: Avery sits in the bathtub. She closes her eyes and relaxes her muscles that are sore from training. There is a sound of the door opening. Avery speaks with her eyes closed. AVERYThank you for bringing me the herbs, Hayley. Just leave them here. No one answers. There is a rustling sound behind her, and then some herbs with petals are poured into the tub. Avery opens her eyes in surprise and sees Xavier who squats beside the tub and puts herbs in. AVERY(CONT'D)(surprised)Xavier! She sinks her body down, covers herself with foam. Xavier frowns and says impatiently. XAVIERHayley asked me to bring this stuff to you. AVERY(embarrassed)Thanks…… You can leave now.

Xavier looks at Avery. He moves closer to her. His arms braces against both of her side and moves closer to Avery’s nose to sniff her scent. XAVIERYou smells like Darren. His scent is all over your body, disgusting. Avery gets angry because of Xavier’s creepy attitude. She puts her hands on his chest to push him away but fails. AVERYDoes that bother you? Xavier holds Avery’s hands and squeezes her hand tight. XAVIERKeep your distance with him. You’re my mate. AVERYI can’t. He’s training me. Are you jealous or something? Xavier grabs Avery's hands with his left hand and clasps her neck with his right hand. His lips are close to hers, as if about to kiss her. XAVIERJealous about you? No. You shouldn’t have asked him to train you, just stop stirring up trouble. Avery looks at Xavier provocatively. She breaks away from Xavier and traces his brow with her lathered hand. AVERY(seducing)What do you mean stir up trouble? Like this? The next minute, she pulls the collar of Xavier’s shirt and pulls him into the bathtub.
INT. THE MOUNTAIN PACK - VILLA - AVERY’S BATHROOM - NIGHT12
location: INT THE MOUNTAIN PACK - VILLA - AVERY’S BATHROOM

text: The water in the bathtub quickly soaks Xavier’s white shirt, and his strong muscles are visible. Avery moves closer to Xavier. She runs her hand down his open collar. Then she kisses him. Xavier's pupils dilates and his breath begins ragged. He presses Avery's neck and kisses her heavily. They share a deep kiss.

When Xavier moves to kiss Avery’s shoulder, she pushes him away. AVERYI have to prepare for tomorrow’s training. Have a good night, my Alpha. Avery stands up. She takes a towel from the side and wraps herself in it before she leaves. Xavier sits in the tub and watches Avery’s departing back frustratedly. XAVIERUgh! Why can’t I resist her pheromones!
INT. THE MOUNTAIN PACK - RESTAURANT - DAY13
location: INT THE MOUNTAIN PACK - RESTAURANT

text: Avery and Darren walk into the restaurant and sit next to the window. Darren passes the menu to Avery. DARREN(encouraging)You’re great. The training has been intense these past few days and you handled it well. Avery looks at him with a hint of gratitude in her eyes. AVERYGreat is not enough, I wanna be the best. What are we working on next? DARREN(smiles)Attagirl! I like your attitude but you don't have to push yourself so hard. Suddenly, the sounds of giggles interrupt them. Avery looks up to find Xavier and Isabel walking into the restaurant. Xavier notices Avery and Darren, then he extends his arm, signaling for Isabel to take it, and Isabel loops hers through his. Xavier whispers into Isabel’s ear. Isabel laughs even louder, and glances at Avery coldly. Anger builds inside Avery, who bites her lower lip. DARREN(CONT'D)He's doing it on purpose. Ignore them. Avery looks at Darren, gratitude flashing in her eyes.

AVERY(whispers)Please cooperate with me. Darren looks at Avery with a puzzled look in his eyes, but understands when Avery reaches out and messes up his hair. He gives Avery a reassuring smile and holds her hands. DARRENYou’re so amazing, Luna. Xavier's attention shifts to them, seeing Avery and Darren holding hands together. He pushes Isabel away at first but the next second, he holds Isabel’s shoulders tight and walks towards Avery and Darren. XAVIERDo you mind if we join you? Avery looks at Xavier and smiles. AVERYOf course we mind. Ignoring Avery's rejection, Xavier snaps his fingers, and a waiter comes over. XAVIERTwo more sets of utensils here.
INT. THE MOUNTAIN PACK - RESTAURANT - DAY14
location: INT THE MOUNTAIN PACK - RESTAURANT

text: Xavier, Avery, Darren and Isabel sit at a table, with Xavier and Isabel sitting on one side and Avery and Darren sitting on the other. The waiter serves the food. XAVIERThank you. Avery angrily tightens her grip on the utensils in her hand, takes a deep breath, preparing to confront Xavier. Seeing this, Darren hastily catches Avery’s wrist and shakes his head lightly. Avery stares at Xavier and then she smiles. She pours a glass of wine and hands it to Darren. AVERYTry it. It tastes good. DARRENThank you, Luna.

AVERY(smiles to Darren)Just call me Avery. Xavier stars at Avery with anger written in his eyes. Isabel holds Xavier’s arm and says. ISABELAlpha, can I taste your steak? XAVIERJust call me Xavier. He cuts off a piece of steak and feeds it to Isabel. Darren passes Avery a piece of bread, Avery eats. AVERYThank you, Darren. You’re so gentle. Darren smiles and wipes the crumbs from Avery’s mouth. Xavier’s expression turns stormy. He stops the fork with a steak chunk half way to his mouth and puts the fork down back to the plate. He gazes into Avery’s eyes. XAVIERWhat’s wrong with you? AVERYI’m just having my lunch. Xavier stands up and walks to Avery. He grabs Avery’s wrist, tries to pull her away. Avery struggles, tries to shake his hand off while Darren stands up to confront Xavier. DARRENWhat are you doing? XAVIER(to Darren)Don't you ever question me. I am your Alpha. AVERYSo this is your alpha behavior. XAVIER(says to Avery)Remember your place. You’re my mate. After saying that, he shakes off her hand and turns away. Isabel picks up her purse and chases after Xavier.
INT. THE MOUNTAIN PACK - RESTAURANT - DAY15
location: INT THE MOUNTAIN PACK - RESTAURANT

text: Isabel and Xavier stand together. Xavier sneaks a peak inside, seeing Avery slump down, looking defeated. Darren pats her shoulder to comfort her. ISABELXavier, don’t you think Avery and Darren are too intimate? XAVIER(frowns unsatisfied)I’ll make her remember who her mate is.
INT. THE MOUNTAIN PACK - AVERY’S ROOM - DAY18
location: INT THE MOUNTAIN PACK - AVERY’S ROOM

text: Avery stars at Xavier. Xavier kneels in front of Avery, his fingers caresses her legs, slowly spreads her legs. Avery moans. He lowers his head, tentatively touching her leg with the tip of his nose, then kisses her leg. XAVIERDo you want me to continue? LAURA(immerse herself in it)Yes.

Xavier kisses her which makes her breath rapidly, then Xavier release her lips and waits. XAVIERYou know what to do. Avery gasps as she answers Darren. AVERYDarren, I’m okay. I’ll see you tomorrow. As Darren’s footsteps drifts away, Xavier kisses Avery heavily. They stand up, kissing from the chair to the floor-to-ceiling window. Xavier wraps an arm around Avery's waist, turning her to face the window. He lowers his head to kiss her deeply. The hot atmosphere between them fogs up the window. XAVIERI really want to mark you here. AVERYThen do it. Xavier gently grips Avery’s chin, guiding her gaze toward the window. He whispers in her ear. XAVIERDarren’s gonna see us. INT. THE MOUNTAIN PACK - OUTSIDE OF AVERY’S ROOM - DAY18A Camera turns to the outside, we can see Darren outside.

Xavier lets go of Avery and puts on his shirt. AVERYAre you doing this on purpose? XAVIERI’m not looking to be the alpha everyone laughs at. Xavier turns to leave. Avery looks at his back, she speaks to herself. AVERYDoes he even like me or is he just mad at me? I need to figure it out.

EXT. THE MOUNTAIN PACK - TRAINING GROUND - EARLY MORNING19 SCENERY SHOT: THE WHOLE PACK EXERCISING IN THE MORNING LIGHT. Avery runs to Darren, carrying a small basket. She takes out an apple pie from the basket and hands it to Darren. AVERYI made some apple pie, have a taste. Thank you for training me. Darren takes the apple pie and eats. DARRENIt’s delicious. I like it. Avery puts down the basket and starts to do some warm ups. Darren puts his hands on her shoulders to help her stretch. Avery glances back at Xavier in the distance, a smile showing at the corners of her mouth, then she quickly focused on her training again. From a distance, Xavier watches Avery and Darren, he clenches his fists. Johnson appears behind him with a pie in his hand. XAVIER(looks at Johnson)What’s this? JOHNSONIt’s an apple pie made by the Luna. She didn't give you? Xavier looks at the apple pie in Johnson’s hand and become puzzled and angry. XAVIER(angrily)I don’t want apple pie anyway. JOHNSONReally? But I remember apple pie is your favorite. XAVIER(frowns angrily)Is your training not challenging enough? You have time for pie? Johnson finishes the pie quickly and turns to leave. He walks two steps and then turns to Xavier, asks tentatively. JOHNSONAre you jealous, Alpha? A hint of embarrassment and irritation surfaces on Xavier’s face, he answers furiously.
XAVIERWhy would I be jealous of an apple pie made by an Omega?
INT. THE MOUNTAIN PACK - BANQUET HALL - NIGHT21
location: INT THE MOUNTAIN PACK - BANQUET HALL

text: Everyone gather to celebrate the annual party, the jovial atmosphere is palpable with laughter and dancing. Laura enters, wearing the beautiful dress. Lily and Isabel stands together. Their eyes immediately lock on Avery. ISABELThe little Omega, she’s pretty. LILYShe’s just pretty, that’s all. Let’s wait until the day of the challenge, she’ll be crying then. Avery looks at Xavier who is chatting with Johnson, feels her gaze, Xavier turns to look at Avery, their eyes intertwine. Hayley approaches Avery and admires her dress, Avery takes back her sight and starts to chat with Hayley. HAYLEYYou look amazing, Avery. Tonight, you're the center of attention. AVERY(smiles happily)Thank you, Hayley. Xavier picked this dress. Darren enters, overhearing the conversation. He steps closer to Avery. Hayley excuses herself. DARRENShe’s not wrong. You look especially beautiful tonight. Avery smiles, her cheeks flushing. AVERYYou always know how to make me happy. A romantic song plays over the speakers. Darren reaches out his hand. DARRENMay I have this dance, with the prettiest girl tonight? Avery stars at Xavier who prepares to walk to her while Isabel interrupts. Avery swallows the rejection that comes to her lips and puts her hand in Darren's. AVERYOf course, it'd be my pleasure. At the meantime, Isabel asks Xavier.

ISABELAlpha, may I have this dance? Xavier’s eyes does not leave Avery. He reaches out and sweeps Isabel into his arms as he begins to dance. He raises an eyebrow at Avery with a provocative emotion. Isabel notices Xavier’s attention is entirely on Avery and Darren, she frowns. ISABEL(CONT'D)(unhappy)Do you like that weak Omega? Like a deer caught in headlights, Xavier turns to Isabel. XAVIERDo I look like I fancy her? ISABELI'm just worried about what will happen if the Alpha starts caring about the weak Luna. That won't turn out well. Lily looks at Avery and Darren dancing together, she rolls her eyes in exasperation, then she takes a drink from the desk, walks towards Avery.
INT. THE MOUNTAIN PACK - HALLWAY - DAY16 16
location: INT THE MOUNTAIN PACK - HALLWAY

text: Darren walks Avery to the door of her room, they stand in the corridor. Avery smiles at Darren. AVERYThank you for supporting me today at the restaurant. Darren smiles back and answers sincerely. DARRENAnytime you need, my Luna. Xavier suddenly appears at the end of the corridor, with anger and jealousy written in his eyes, he walks straight to Avery. Ignores Darren and Avery’s shocked face, Xavier takes Avery’s wrist and drags her into the room. The door slams heavily in front of Darren's face.
INT. THE MOUNTAIN PACK - AVERY’S ROOM - DAY17
location: INT THE MOUNTAIN PACK - AVERY’S ROOM

text: Avery struggles when Xavier pushes her forcefully against the wall and puts one of his hand on the back of her neck to pull her closer and kiss her. After an intense kiss, Avery pushes Xavier away. AVERYWhat are you doing now? Xavier looks at Avery deeply. XAVIERWhy are you so close with Darren? AVERYHe’s my friend!

At the same time, there is a knock on the door, Darren’s voice rings out. DARREN (V.O.)Avery, are you alright? Xavier’s eyes immediately turn cold, he picks Avery up and presses her into a nearby chair, his body tightly encircling her into it. His lips trace hers. XAVIEROmega, you really pissed me off. AVERY(whispers)Xavier…… stop. XAVIERYou want my attention? Your little stunt with Darren worked. What else do you want? Avery looks into Xavier’s eyes and then she grabs him by the collar of his shirt. AVERY(seductively)You. I want you. Xavier kisses Avery heavily. Avery unbuttons his shirt. Xavier is almost naked. The knock comes again, Darren’s voice rings out. DARREN(V.O.)Avery? I’m worried about you. Xavier brushes Avery’s lips by his fingers. He says in a seductive voice. XAVIERTell him to leave.
INT. THE MOUNTAIN PACK - BANQUET HALL - NIGHT22
location: INT THE MOUNTAIN PACK - BANQUET HALL

Avery is stunned. AVERYBut I’m your Luna. I’m not your mate. DARRENI know. But these feelings—I've carried them for so long, I had to tell you. AVERYDarren…… I’m so sorry, my heart belongs to Xavier. Trust me, you’ll find your true love one day. Avery embraces Darren as a friend. Darren lowers his head and notices the necklace in Avery’s neck, he forces a smile.
DARRENAs your friend, I already knew your answer. Come, let me take you where you belong. Avery follows him toward the villa, curious.

Darren would never address me that way. So show yourself! Elijah emerges from the darkness. He snaps his fingers and Darren immediately ties Avery up like a puppet. Avery struggles but fails. AVERY(full of surprised)You knew my mom?!

location: INT ABANDONED WAREHOUSE

text: Elijah walks towards Avery while he says.

ELIJAHYour mother, Emily, she was the most beautiful girl I’d ever met. We were in love until your father stole her away from me. AVERY(struggles)I don’t trust you! My parents loved each other! What do you want from me! Elijah grips her chin, he stares at Avery’s face deeply. ELIJAHThe resemblance is uncanny…… Elijah cups Avery’s chin and tries to kiss her forcibly. AVERYDon’t touch me! With her hands tied up, she can not move. In desperation, a purple light flashes in her eyes and pushes Elijah away. Elijah laughs crazily, he approaches Avery again and squeezes her chin. He pours a vial of potion down her throat.Avery struggles but still swallows some of the potion. Elijah cups Avery’s face, his eyes emit a red glow. ELIJAH(hypnotizing)Stay with me. I'll love you like I loved your mother. Avery’s voice fades, her eyes gradually become dull. Elijah smiles and kisses Avery’s face. ELIJAH(CONT'D)Emily, my Emily, you're finally all mine again. He strokes Avery's face greedily and smells her scent. Then he picks up her, her body dangling limply, and walks out. XAVIERAvery! Xavier rushes in. Elijah carefully puts Avery down. Xavier punches him on the face. Elijah grits his teeth. ELIJAHWhy do you pesky werewolves always ruin my plans? XAVIERUndo the things you did to my Luna!

Xavier rushes towards Elijah and grabs him by the collar and pins him against the wall. Darren, who stands in the corner of the cabin takes out a dagger and walks to him, he stabs the dagger into Xavier’s shoulder, moving like a puppet.
INT. ABANDONED WAREHOUSE - DAY92 92
location: INT ABANDONED WAREHOUSE

text: Xavier goes pale and collapses. Avery bursts with great power in her grief. A purple light envelops the whole cabin, she breaks Elijah’s hypnosis and cries out. AVERYXavier!! She breaks free of the ropes and rushes to Xavier. She kneels on the ground, holding his head, trying to wake him up but nothing happens. Elijah looks at her. ELIJAHOh, I should mention, the dagger is laced with a potent poison. Elijah raises his hand, smiling towards Darren who holds the dagger and moves towards Avery. AVERYDarren, stop! A purple light flashes in Avery’s eyes and flies towards Darren, breaking the hypnosis. Darren drops the dagger. DARRENAvery? What’s going on here? Seeing the tables turn, Elijah leaves the cabin with a quick flicker, his voice hanging in the air. ELIJAH (V.O.)We’ll meet again, sweetheart.
INT. THE MOUNTAIN PACK - XAVIER'S ROOM - DAY93
location: INT THE MOUNTAIN PACK - XAVIER'S ROOM

text: Avery and Darren stand around the unconscious Xavier in the bed. Hayley rushes to them. HAYLEYWhat happened? Is he okay? AVERYHe was struck by a poisoned dagger, a vampire did it. Hayley checks him over, her face filled with concern.

HAYLEYI did my best, but the poison is too potent. There's nothing more I can do. AVERYWhat can I do? There must be something. HAYLEYThe witches must know what to do. They’re proficient in healing techniques and mysterious powers.But they live deep in the forest. No one could find them. Avery clenches her fists, her eyes resolute. AVERYI’ll go find them. DARRENI’ll go with you. I’m sorry…… Avery shakes her head. AVERYDon’t blame yourself, Darren. I was the target, not you. HAYLEYTake care. Avery nods and turns to leave, Darren follows her.

text: Deep in the forest, Darren and Avery walk, exhausted. DARRENThis area doesn't seem like it's inhabited. AVERYHush……listen…… Darren shuts up and listens but hears nothing. DARRENAvery, I don’t think there's anything…… Avery interrupts Darren by snapping in the air and suddenly, a lady who hides behind a big tree appears in front of them.

location: INT THE MOUNTAIN PACK - XAVIER'S ROOM

text: Darren, Avery and Anya return hurriedly to see Hayley, Isabel, Johnson and Lily gather together, surrounding the bed. Lily sees Darren and there is a flash of joy in her eyes. ANYAThis poison is extremely rare, only the herb “Moonlight” could solve this.

location: EXT FOREST

text: Avery and Xavier go ahead and Darren follows them. AVERYHe said it’s here. Where is he? Suddenly, Elijah flashes out. He swiftly lunges at Xavier, points the dagger straight at his chest. Darren pushes Xavier away, but gets impaled by the weapon himself. XAVIER & AVERYDarren!

That Hayley, she’s adorable. XAVIERDon't you dare touch her! Xavier rushes to fight with Elijah, Avery changes into human form, rushes to check Darren who bleeding profusely. AVERYDarren, I can save you, just hang on. Avery kneels aside, one hand tightly holds Darren's hand, the other casting a spell on his wound. But his vitality is fading away. Avery's face gradually turns pale. Suddenly a pair of large hands grab hers, it’s Darren. DARRENDon't cry……I know you wanna save me…… But somethings…… you can't change. Avery's tears fall, wetting Darren's hand. AVERYNo, we can't give up. I can’t lose you. Please stay with me…… Darren smiles, stroking Avery's face with trembling hand. DARRENYou can’t hurt yourself anymore. There’s a heartbeat inside of you. Avery holds Darren's hand, sobs and gathers energy again. AVERYWhat are you taking about?Please, stop talking, save some energy.
DARREN(stops Avery)You’re a mother now. Take care. I'm glad to have such an amazing friend like you. Tell Lily my answer is yes. Darren's hand slowly falls, his eyes lose focus.

location: EXT FOREST

text: Xavier takes out the dagger, he attempts to attack Elijah. However, with an unimaginable speed, Elijah dodges and pins Xavier down. He puts the dagger to Xavier’s neck. ELIJAHYou missed, like poor James. It’s not that easy to kill me. Avery wipes her tears off and walks over to Elijah. AVERYI’ll go with you. Let Xavier go. Xavier struggles, he yells to Avery in pain. XAVIERAvery! Don’t! Elijah looks at Avery with a searching gaze, he reaches his hand to Avery. When she takes it, he gradually releases Xavier. ELIJAHThat’s my good girl. Elijah holds Avery in his arms. A purple light flashes in her eyes and attacks Elijah. Avery takes out the real dagger and slashes Elijah’s arm, he roars in pain and falls to the ground. ELIJAH(CONT'D)How could this be possible? You tricked me with a fake dagger! Avery holds the real dagger towards Elijah. AVERY Elijah, this is your end. You need to pay for what you did to my father! To Darren!

Xavier walks over to Avery. He takes the dagger from her hand and thrusts it into Elijah’s chest who spits out a mouthful of blood and closes his eyes. Xavier tightly wraps Avery in his arms. Their foreheads touch. XAVIERIt’s all over, Avery.
